newsitem.title: USA: CSX restructures $2.050 bln debt offering.
newsitem.headline: CSX restructures $2.050 bln debt offering.

text.p: CSX Corp on Wednesday restructured its $2.050 billion 144A offering to include a $350 million tranche of 30-year debt with an eight-year put option, market sources said.
The 30-year put eight debt replaces a 30-year non-callable capital securities tranche, the sources added.
The multi-tranche deal is expected to consist of follows with unofficial price talk of:
-$350 million five-year debt at 55 basis points over Treasuries.
-$350 million seven-year debt at 65 basis points over Treasuries.
-$350 million 10-year debt at 80 basis points over Treasuries.
-$650 million 30-year debt at 105 basis points over Treasuries.
- $350 million 30-year put eight debt at 60 basis points over Treasuries.
CSX Corp and lead underwriter Salomon Brothers Inc declined comment.
